exposure: Prolonged left lateral position before supine position with left lateral tilt
cohort: Sixty parturients undergoing cesarean section at Gaziantep University Hospital between June and December 2011
finding: Keeping parturients in a lateral position for 15 minutes before turning them to the supine position for cesarean section can provide reliable spinal anesthesia with a lower incidence and severity of hypotension and nausea/vomiting.
